direction: Daily MACD-histogram positive state, unlevered spot long/cash.
hypothesis: The difference between a fast-slow EMA spread and its9-day EMA may identify changes in momentum earlier than a raw trend-level filter. Test whether daily histogram-positive exposure survives costs and regimes; no claim of predictability or independently confirmed profit.

sources.scope: Primary MACD=fastMA-slowMA, signal=EMA(MACD), histogram=MACD-signal definition. Our explicit long/cash rules, spans, seed and costs are not profitability endorsed by this source.
EMA span alpha=2/(span+1), adjustFalse first-observation seed and recursive formula. Implemented in Decimal28 without pandas dependency.
Official filter definitions; historical filters remain unavailable.

rule.signal: At fixed dataset day0 seed each price EMA with first completed close. For spanN,alpha=2/(N+1),E_t=E_previous+alpha*(close_t-E_previous),Decimal28. MACD=EMA_fast-EMA_slow. Seed signalEMA9 with MACD0=0, update by the same recurrence;histogram=MACD-signal. No OOS/fold resets.
rule.entry: When flat, enter iff current completed histogram>0; no prior-cross requirement, including the first OOS decision.
rule.exit: When long, exit iff histogram<=0. Zero stays cash or exits long. No short, MACD-level filter, hold cap or same-decision re-entry; terminal liquidation remains costed.
rule.execution: Signal becomes available at the signal candle close; if target changes, simulate an order at the next UTC day 00:01 one-minute open (60-second delay). Rejected orders are not backfilled; the same desired state may be tried on a later new daily decision. At the frozen OOS terminal timestamp, liquidate any open lot with costs.
rule.account: Independent 2,000 USDT single-asset cash account for every asset×parameter combination; all initial capital assigned to the specified asset sleeve, no leverage, borrowing, shorting, transfer or cash interest.

time_boundaries.walk_forward: 12 consecutive, non-overlapping 30-day evaluation windows; account remains continuous across windows; no fitting, parameter selection or fold reset.
time_boundaries.history_note: The 2025–2026 OOS window has been reused extensively in this repository and is not an untouched final holdout.

validation.neighborhood: Same asset, adjacent lookback index and adjacent hurdle index in the frozen 3×3 grid; 3×3 neighborhood including center.
validation.multiple_testing: No DSR/PBO claim: repeated reused-OOS history and many prior strategy trials create material selection bias.
validation.purging: No fitted model or future-return labels; label purge inapplicable. All EMAs start at fixed dataset day0 and update only on completed closes, carrying seed memory through365day context,3day initial gap and12folds without resets. No OOS parameter selection.
validation.continuous_drawdown: Initial capital plus all OOS minute-close and immediate post-fill marks; no fold reset or intraminute extrema.

costs.impact: 0.5 × sample stdev of previous 20 complete UTC daily log returns × sqrt(order quote budget / previous 20 complete daily quote ADV)
costs.filters_source: Unchanged 2026-10-14 frozen public exchangeInfo proxy, checked against the current public response in filter_check.json. Reuse the original hash so retrieval timestamps cannot manufacture novelty. Historical L2 and historical filters are unavailable.

data.format: Archived Binance spot 1m OHLCV; daily closes and quote ADV are aggregated from fully closed UTC days.

prior_results.last_batch: 18 RSI momentum configurations rejected; positive cases were one-round-trip paths.
prior_results.distinction: Use fast-slow EMA spread minus its9-day EMA, not a price-range score, RSI level or two-EMA level crossover. No MACD-level>0 or other regime filter.

account_scope: Offline research only. Read existing paper10 and delayed SMA-shadow accounts without reset, replacement, new paper observations or real orders.
